subject: PO ingestion & AP onboarding: ledger fields, VAT proof, and early-pay option
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@helmbridge.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Procure AP <ap@helmbridge.io>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: AP onboarding / PO ingestion sample + VAT evidence request

Hi Priya / Laura,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We're preparing Helmbridge's supplier record for Redwood and want to confirm the exact PO and invoice fields you need so our ledger team can push a clean CSV. A few specific asks from our side: 

- Can Redwood accept free-text PO references or do you require a strict PO number format (numeric only)?
- Required CSV columns for PO ingestion (we currently export: po_number, po_date, line_description, qty, unit_price, tax_rate, account_code, remit_entity). Any additional required fields?
- When an invoice references multiple POs (partial fulfillment), how does your AP match behavior work? Do you support multiple PO links per invoice?
- VAT: we operate in IE/UK. What evidence do you need for VAT reverse-charge / tax exemption (VAT ID, supplier self-cert, invoice wording)?
- Remit: do you prefer EFT with beneficiaries pre-validated or a PDF bank proof is OK?

I've attached a sample Helmbridge_PO_sample.csv (redacted).

Goal: get a checklist and a short AP packet from Redwood so we can complete your vendor registration by the end of next week. Optional: we may request an early-payment opt-in later; please point us to the cadence and fee flow.

Thanks,
Samantha Cole
Head of Procurement Operations
Helmbridge Logistics Ltd

Attachment: Helmbridge_PO_sample.csv (3 rows, redacted)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@helmbridge.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AP onboarding / PO ingestion sample + VAT evidence request

Hi Samantha — thanks for the sample and the clear list. Looping in Aditya (ops) and Laura (finance) to confirm a couple of specifics; sending our AP onboarding packet in the meantime.

Short answers up front: 
- PO format: we accept alphanumeric PO IDs but prefer a distinct PO field. If you can export po_number as a single column that’s ideal.
- Required CSV columns: we require po_number, invoice_number, invoice_date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd), line_description, qty, unit_price, tax_rate, net_amount, gross_amount, currency, remit_entity, remit_country, supplier_vat_id (if available). Optional but recommended: internal_account_code and project_code.
- Multiple POs: invoices can be linked to multiple PO numbers (we support a pipe-separated field in ingestion, e.g., PO-1|PO-2); Ops will validate matching rules during UAT.
- VAT evidence: for IE/UK reverse-charge we need supplier VAT ID and either (a) supplier self-cert (simple signed PDF), or (b) export of your VAT registration confirmation. We'll attach a short checklist in the packet.
- Bank proof: PDF bank proof is fine for initial boarding; EFT beneficiary validation will be requested before first settlement.

Attached: redwood-ap-onboarding-packet_v2.pdf (contains CSV template, required legal names, remit flow, and the UAT checklist).

Action items: 
1) Samantha — can you return the Helmbridge vendor legal name exactly as it should appear on invoices and the VAT ID?
2) Aditya — please confirm whether the ingestion supports pipe-delimited multiple PO links and whether we need a separate "po_line_id" for line-level matching.
3) Laura — confirm whether Redwood Finance requires a signed W-8/W-9 equivalent for Helmbridge (given IE residency we expect VAT forms only).

Thanks — Priya
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-ap-onboarding-packet_v2.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@helmbridge.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AP onboarding / PO ingestion sample + VAT evidence request

Thanks Priya / Samantha — quick finance notes so expectations are clear before ingestion/UAT: 

- Legal name: Helmbridge Logistics Ltd must match the supplier record exactly (including punctuation). If invoices show a different trading name we need a short attestation document.
- VAT: we require the VAT ID on the supplier record and on each invoice that claims reverse charge. Acceptable evidence: national VAT registration extract or a signed supplier self-cert PDF (simple one-page form). We don't require W-8/W-9 for IE entities — VAT is sufficient.
- PO matching: Redwood finance will match at invoice line level when a po_line_id is present. If not present, we'll attempt best-effort matching by line_description + qty + unit_price. For multi-PO invoices, include PO numbers in a single pipe-delimited CSV field (as Priya noted).
- Currency & rounding: include currency ISO (EUR/GBP) and ensure gross_amount equals net_amount + tax_amount; mismatches will flag the invoice.
- Remit / EFT: a PDF bank proof is acceptable to create the vendor record. Before first settlement we require a micro-deposit or bank API validation.

Please upload the signed supplier self-cert (if available) and the bank proof to the Drive link Priya shared. Once we receive the validated CSV and documents we will schedule a 1-hour UAT window (ops + finance) to run ingestion against the sandbox. Expect a 3–5 business day validation period after UAT.

Attachment: redwood-bank-proof.pdf

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@helmbridge.io>

Subject: Re: AP onboarding / PO ingestion sample + VAT evidence request

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. Next steps from Helmbridge: 

1) We'll return a signed self-cert (supplier_self_cert_helmbridge.pdf) and a PDF bank proof by end of day Friday.
2) We'll re-export our PO CSV to include the additional columns you listed and use pipe-delimited PO links for multi-PO invoices. Expect a sanitized sample in the Drive folder by Friday morning.
3) Sample PO for UAT: PO-GL-2026-7894 (currency EUR). Please confirm that ID will be accepted (alphanumeric + dash).
4) Early-pay: we'd like to opt into early payment for the UAT invoice set to test the marketplace flow - can you confirm fees and whether Redwood's early-pay provider supports EUR settlements to IE banks?
5) HubSpot deal id: HB-DEAL-45321 (we added it to the packet).

If everything looks good we'll aim to complete vendor registration and schedule UAT next Tuesday 21 Sep. Can you share the DocuSign link for the supplier self-cert or a Drive upload location?
